name: ConstructionMaterials
description: Root node for all materials

name: Aggregates
description: Construction Aggregates, including sand, gravel, crushed stone, etc. for use as bases, ballasts, or as a component in concrete or asphalt

name: Aluminium
description: Broad category for construction materials made primarily from Aluminium and its alloys

name: AluminiumExtrusions
description: Extruded aluminum products used in construction with of a range of finish options including mill finish, painted, and anodized.

name: Asphalt
description: General category for asphalt mixtures

name: CMU
description: Pre-manufactured concrete masonry blocks

name: Cladding
description: Nonstructural materials used primarily on the outside of buildings

name: InsulatedRoofPanels
description: Insulated metal panel (IMP) for roof applications

name: InsulatedWallPanels
description: Insulated metal panel (IMP) for exterior wall applications

name: RoofPanels
description: Solid roofing panels for exterior face of building, made typically of metal, wood, plastic, or composite materials

name: WallPanels
description: Solid panels for exterior wall face of building, made of, e.g., metal, wood, tile, terra cotta, cementitious materials, or composite materials

name: Concrete
description: A composite material composed of fine and coarse aggregate bonded together with a fluid cement (cement paste) that hardens over time

name: CementGrout
description: Cement grouting is a slurry that is placed as a flowable liquid. It is an effective material for filling and strengthening granular soils, voids in rocks, foundation underpinnings, and other underground voids. Also called structural grout, these materials typically impart significant compressive strength to the system.

name: FlowableFill
description: Flowable fill is a slurry that is placed as a flowable liquid (high slump) and sets with no compaction. It is often used in tight or restricted access areas where placing and compacting fill is difficult. Applications include filling large voids such as abandoned underground storage tanks, basements, tunnels, mines, and sewers. It can also be used as paving sub-base, bridge abutment, and retaining wall backfill. Also called Controlled Density Fill (CDF) or Controlled Low Strength Materials (CLSMs). These materials typically have compressive strengths under 1200 psi.

name: ReadyMix
description: Concretes to be mixed and then poured on-site

name: Shotcrete
description: Concretes sprayed on a target

name: ConveyingEquipment
description: Conveying Equipment

name: Elevators
description: Car that moves in a vertical shaft to carry passengers or freight between the levels of a multistory building.

name: Finishes
description: General category - finishes for interior ceilings, floors, walls

name: CeilingPanel
description: Acoustical and other specialty ceiling panels

name: AcousticalCeilings
description: Acoustical ceiling panels

name: CementBoard
description: Hard cementitious boards, typically used as a tile backer.

name: Flooring
description: General category - finishes for floors

name: Carpet
description: Textile Floor Coverings

name: ResilientFlooring
description: Resilient floor products (including vinyl, rubber, linoleum, composition cork, etc.) in modular square or rectangle shapes

name: Gypsum
description: Gypsum board used for interior walls, ceilings, and similar applications.

name: PaintingAndCoating
description: Paintings and coatings

name: PaintByArea
description: Paintings and coatings measured by area of host surface covered by the ready-to-use product.

name: PaintByMass
description: Paintings and coatings measured by mass of ready-to-use product.

name: PaintByVolume
description: Paintings and coatings measured by volume of ready-to-use product.

name: Tiling
description: Decorative building materials that includes a variety of ceramic, porcelain, and glass tiles, used for covering and enhancing surfaces such as floors, walls, and countertops.

name: CeramicTile
description: Ceramic tiles, including porcelain, quarry, pressed floor tile, wall tile, mosaic tile, etc.

name: GaugedTile
description: Specially manufactured porcelain tile with extra-large panels/slabs manufactured to a specific thickness ranging from 2-20 mm

name: GlassTile
description: Glass Tiles

name: FireAndSmokeProtection
description: General category of materials whose function is to provide protection of materials, spaces, and occupants from fire and smoke damage

name: AppliedFireproofing
description:
Fireproofing material applied to structural materials including: cement aggregate,
cementitious, magnesium-oxychloride, intumescent, magnesium cement, mineral fiber, and mineral fiber
fireproofing products.

name: IntumescentFireproofing
description:
Fireproofing material applied to structural materials, which swells as a result of heat exposure, thus
increasing in volume and decreasing in density.

name: SprayFireproofing
description:
A passive fire protection system that reduces the rate of temperature increase
in concrete or steel during a fire

name: ManufacturingInputs
description: Broad category for collecting materials primarily used as manufacturing inputs, rather than directly used in a construction.

name: CementitiousMaterials
description: General category for cements and cement components.

name: Cement
description: Cements, including Portland and blended cements, that can serve as the primary binder in a concrete mix.

name: SupplementaryCementitiousMaterials
description: Cementitious materials that are not effective binders when used on their own.

name: Masonry
description: Structural and/or enclosure system based on individual rigid units stacked and bound together with mortar

name: Brick
description: Solid masonry units made from clay or shale

name: NetworkInfrastructure
description: General category for network infrastructure products for data centers and commercial and residential buildings

name: DataCabling
description: Telecommunications cabling for buildings

name: Openings
description: General category that includes windows, storefronts, window walls, curtain walls, doors, entrances, etc.

name: Glazing
description: Broad category of glass-based products, accessories, and assemblies ranging from glass panes and framing to curtain walls.

name: FenestrationParts
description: Parts and assemblies for integration into building fenestration such as windows, curtain walls, and storefronts.

name: FenestrationAccessories
description: Gaskets, seals, fasteners, and other low-mass items which may be useful in calculating the impact of a fenestration system.

name: GlassPanes
description: Flat glass panes

name: FlatGlassPanes
description: Monolithic, uncoated flat glass panes that are not substantially processed.

name: ProcessedNonInsulatingGlassPanes
description:
Solid glass panes without internal gaps which have been heat-treated or otherwise substantially processed. Includes:
1. Coatings including low-e and other coatings (see PCR)
2. laminating (fire-rated, glass clad polycarbonate, interlayers
3. Heat treated (heat strengthened, tempered, fire-rated)
4. Mechanically or chemically processed or fabricated (edging, bending, etching, drilling, notching, cutting, polishing, etc)
5. combined products of processing in 1-5.

name: InsulatingGlazingUnits
description: A factory-made unit of two or more panes of glass separated by a sealed insulating gap. IGUs often incorporate coated, laminated, or heat treated glass along with with airspace, gas fill, seals, and spacers.

name: Placeholders
description: A category to stand in for materials that are not currently handled in EC3, but where we want to be able to bind an element and retain its dimensions. Impacts for placeholders are always considered to be zero.

name: Airspace
description: Represents air-filled gaps in designs

name: AreaPlaceholder
description: An undefined material with a declared unit of area and an assumed impact of zero.

name: LengthPlaceholder
description: An undefined material with a declared unit of length and an assumed impact of zero.

name: MassPlaceholder
description: An undefined material with a declared unit of mass and an assumed impact of zero.

name: Negligible
description: This material's impact is small enough to be ignored.

name: ReusedComponent
description: This component was reused from a previous structure. Its net impact is treated as zero (i.e. fully amortized in its previous use).

name: VolumePlaceholder
description: An undefined material with a declared unit of volume and an assumed impact of zero.

name: PrecastConcrete
description: General category for precast concrete components

name: ArchitecturalPrecast
description: Precast concrete cladding used for architectural purposes

name: CivilPrecast
description: Precast concrete used for civil engineering applications including bridges, highways, and railroads.

name: StructuralPrecast
description: Precast concrete used for structural purposes

name: UtilityUndergroundPrecast
description: Precast concrete for utility vaults, manhole, drain inlets. Excludes piping.

name: Sheathing
description: Boards or panels used in floor, wall and roof assemblies as a surface onto which other materials can be applied.

name: CementitiousSheathingBoard
description: Cementitious non-gypsum board used for sheathing exteriors, shaft walls, and interior walls/ceilings requiring moisture resistance.

name: GypsumSheathingBoard
description: Gypsum board used for sheathing exteriors, shaft walls, and interior walls/ceilings requiring moisture resistance.

name: Steel
description: Broad category for construction materials made from steel and its alloys

name: CoilSteel
description: Sheet or strip steel, sold in rolls. Typically, coil steel is cold-formed into light gauge products.

name: ColdFormedSteel
description:
All types of cold formed steel products. These products are made from hot-rolled steel coils and sheets and
are cold formed into products such as studs, decking, panels, and other accessories.

name: ColdFormedFraming
description:
Cold formed steel elements such as studs and framing, typically made from coil or sheet steel
and used within walls and ceilings.

name: DeckingSteel
description: Corrugated Decking made from cold-formed sheet steel. Often filled with concrete.

name: SteelSuspensionAssembly
description: Steel suspension assemblies for suspended (e.g. acoustical) ceiling systems

name: MBQSteel
description: Merchant Bar Quality (MBQ) steel is used as feedstock to steel construction products, but also includes rounds, angles, and light structural shapes.

name: PrefabricatedSteelAssemblies
description: Prefabricated assemblies made primarily of steel.

name: OpenWebMembranes
description: Lightweight steel truss, typically made of parallel chords and a triangulated web system, proportioned to span between bearing points

name: RebarSteel
description: Reinforcing bar used together with concrete.

name: StructuralSteel
description: Hot rolled steel shapes, Hollow Sections, pipes, and similar hot-worked structural steels

name: HollowSections
description: Hollow cross section steel shape, typically referred to as hollow structural section (HSS)

name: HotRolledSections
description: Steel shapes, such as angles, wide flange beams and I-beams, produced using a high temperature mill process.

name: PlateSteel
description: Flat hot-rolled steel, typically thicker than 'sheet', made by compressing multiple steel layers together into one

name: WireMeshSteel
description: Mild steel wire for reinforcement, connections, and meshes

name: ThermalMoistureProtection
description: Broad category of materials whose function is to provide moisture and thermal protection between spaces (e.g., between the exterior and interior of a building)

name: Insulation
description: Thermal insulation materials for use in construction

name: BlanketInsulation
description: Non-rigid insulation batts, blankets, and rolls

name: BlownInsulation
description: Loose-fill insulation for blow-in or closed cavity applications

name: BoardInsulation
description: Rigid insulation products including rigid foams, wood fiberboard insulation, and rigid mineral wool boards

name: FoamedInPlace
description: Open and closed cell spray foam insulation

name: MembraneRoofing
description: Built-up bituminous, modified bituminous, elastomeric, thermoplastic, fluid-applied, and hot-applied rubberized asphalt membrane roofing

name: BituminousRoofing
description: Premanufactured membrane roofing sheets consisting of asphalt, reinforcing layers, and in some cases a surfacing.

name: SinglePlyKEE
description: Ketone Ethylene Ester (KEE) roof membranes consist of PVC resin and KEE plasticizer, with KEE exceeding 50% of the polymer content by weight.

name: SinglePlyPVC
description: Polyvinyl chloride (PVC) thermoplastic membrane.

name: Wood
description: Structural Wood Products used in construction

name: CompositeLumber
description: Shop-fabricated structural Lumber including Laminated Strand Lumber (LSL), Parallel Strand Lumber (PSL), and Laminated Veneer Lumber (LVL)

name: DimensionLumber
description: Dimension lumber for framing, decking, and other purposes.

name: WoodFraming
description: Dimension lumber for light framing. Includes solid and finger-jointed lumber. Standard shapes include 2x4, 2x6, and 2x8.

name: MassTimber
description: Engineered heavy timber products including glue laminated (glulam), cross-laminated timber (CLT), dowel laminated timber (DLT), and nail laminated timber (NLT)

name: NonStructuralWood
description: Non-structural interior and exterior wood products for trim, cabinets, countertops, etc.

name: PrefabricatedWood
description: Prefabricated wood structural members made primarily from one or more types of wood. Includes products made with metallic connectors, insulation, etc. Excludes products where the wood is merely decorative.

name: SheathingPanels
description: Wood sheets used for structural sheathing, including plywood and Oriented Strand Board

name: WoodJoists
description: Prefabricated I-shaped engineered wood structural members made primarily from one or more types of wood. Includes products made with metallic webbing. Excludes products where the wood is merely decorative.
